name: Context menus
author: Brett
description: Every context menu of the app in one place, kept as ONE TRUE SOURCE on axHub (context-menu@1 documents in the hub's shared data, readable and writable by every plugin, app and Claude session through the hub API and the capability context-menus@1). Each menu is a standard context-menu asset the runtime draws; the page lists them all (search, per app / level / zone, who made them, which one each app shows) with Preview, Edit, Use, snapshots and Restore like skins. The zone registry maps every right-click target the code draws (and what open consoles report), with its owner plugin and pages; with the UI Manager on, each zone links to its elements (ui-elements@1). Generate with Claude at a coder level: BEGINNER a few big obvious actions, AMATEUR the common actions, PRO the full working set grouped with shortcuts, ADVANCED CODER a meticulous map of every zone with deep actions (tokens, API addresses, inspect, copy ids, run commands). Higher levels map the app more meticulously; menus stay slim (rare items fold under More…). The level can differ per app and page (a page's own menu wins on that page). Plugins and apps register the actions / hooks they offer on the hub (ctx-actions@1); menus reference them and the list names items nobody offers. The UI Manager (or any plugin) asks context-menus@1 forElement / forZone for the menus of an element. Always a preview before applying. Every right-click menu ends with a Context menus submenu (generate this page's menus at a level, this zone's menus, open the page); it replaces the archived context-menu-plugin-ai-generated-slim build. Greyed out with a clear reason when Claude is not ready. Full API: REST, MCP context_menus_*, `axf context-menus …`, the actions context-menus.* and voice ('generate pro context menus').

items.title: Context menus state
items.description: Every menu (and which one each app shows), the four coder levels, the zone registry, open drafts, whether Claude is ready, where the store is (the hub's shared data = one true source).

items.title: List context menus
items.description: Every context menu, filtered by words (q), app, level, zone or source.

items.title: Every menu per zone and page
items.description: Per zone: the plugin / app that owns it, its pages, elements and the menus that map it (which one is in use); per page: the menus kept for it.

items.title: One context menu
items.description: The context-menu@1 document (the asset inside) and its history list.

items.title: Snapshots of a menu
items.description: Every saved version of one menu (newest first), each a snapshot Restore can put back.

items.title: Zone registry
items.description: Every right-click zone the code draws (data-fx-ctx-target + the implicit toolbar / tab row / nav / anywhere), with owner, weight, pages and elements. scan=true rescans the code.

items.title: Menus for one zone
items.description: What the UI Manager shows for an element: the zone's info, the items the app shows there now, and every menu that maps it.

items.title: Coder levels
items.description: beginner, amateur, pro, advanced: items per zone, depth, which zones, shortcuts, developer actions.

items.title: Actions a menu item may run
items.description: The console inventory plus every action plugins and apps registered on the hub (and who registered what).

items.title: Register the actions a plugin offers
items.description: A plugin or app registers its actions / hooks on the hub (replaces its previous list); menu items reference them by id.

items.title: Actions a menu references that nobody registered
items.description: Item actions in this menu that no plugin or app has registered on the hub, so they would do nothing when picked.

items.title: Which menu an app (or page) shows
items.description: A page's own menu wins on that page; else the app's.

items.title: Stop using a page's (or app's) own menu
items.description: The page (or app) goes back to the menu it inherits: a page falls back to its app menu, an app to its built-in default.

items.title: Open drafts (previews waiting for Apply)
items.description: Generated menus waiting for review: level, app, page and when Claude made them; nothing is in use until Apply.

items.title: One draft with its preview
items.description: One generated draft: the context-menu@1 document and the per-zone preview the plugin renders before Apply.

items.title: Is Claude ready to generate?
items.description: The models service is there; live=true also runs the credits check the Claude badge shows green for.

items.title: The prompt Claude gets
items.description: Zero tokens: the system + user prompt for a level, app and page, with the zones and actions it lists.

items.title: Save a context menu
items.description: Save a context-menu@1 document (validated; the previous version is kept as a snapshot).

items.title: Delete a context menu
items.description: Removes the menu from the hub (its snapshots stay); an app or page that used it falls back to the menu it inherits.

items.title: Restore a snapshot
items.description: Put a menu back to one of its snapshots (v), like a skin.

items.title: Use a menu
items.description: Make this menu the one its app shows (a page menu: only on its page); every open console follows.

items.title: Report the zones on screen
items.description: An open console tells the registry which zones its current page draws (items: [{id, label, elements}], page).

items.title: Generate context menus with Claude
items.description: Map the app's zones at a coder level with Claude and return a DRAFT with a preview (the menu, warnings, what changes against the menu in force). Nothing is applied until apply, unless apply is true. Spends Claude tokens; refused with aiMissing when Claude is not ready.

page.description: one page only (blank = the whole app)

items.output: { ok, draft: ctx-draft@1 { id, menu, warnings, diff, summary }, model }

items.title: Apply a draft
items.description: Save the draft as a menu and make it the one its app shows (use=false saves without switching).

items.title: Discard a draft
items.description: Throws a generated draft away without applying it; menus in use are untouched.

items.title: Voice: one sentence
items.description: 'generate pro context menus', 'preview beginner menus for the console', 'apply', 'list context menus', 'use menu <id>': the sentence is read and run (a generate returns the draft to preview).
